name: Valdana: The Fall
source:
Six powerful women battle against fate.

In a galaxy torn by centuries-long conflict between two superpowers, the queen of Valdana rules over a planet coveted by both Alliance of Free Planets as well as Neo-Terran Confederacy. Having aligned with the former, the fabled Blaze Queen now faces the Neo-Terran punitive fleet. Will she and her allies be able to defend the kingdom and its freedoms? And what is the most dangerous enemy actually lurks within Valdana?

An indirect sequel to Isis: The Fall. Knowledge of previous game’s events is recommended, but not needed.

[From [url=https://tjord.itch.io/valdana]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
六名强大的女性奋起抗争命运。

两大超级势力长达数百年的战火令整片银河四分五裂，而瓦尔达纳女王统治的这颗星球，更是自由行星同盟与新泰拉邦联双方垂涎的焦点。选择倒向前者之后，传说中的“烈焰女王”如今不得不直面新泰拉邦联派出的讨伐舰队。她与盟友能否守住王国与自由？而倘若最危险的敌人，其实就潜伏在瓦尔达纳内部呢？

本作是《Isis: The Fall》的间接续作。建议先了解前作剧情，但未玩过前作亦不影响体验。

[摘自[url=https://tjord.itch.io/valdana]itch.io[/url]]
